construction: Triangle has two shown60° angles and question-only AC=6. Constructed equilateral; only source angle labels are drawn, while embedded prose/choices are excluded.

visual_inspection.method: Every original and every final generated PNG actually viewed in contact sheets at 380px per image; crowded cases zoomed to native768px.
visual_inspection.notes: Compared point names, topology, source marks, label ownership, angle arcs, and margins. Final text/line collisions detected by code were repaired and visually reinspected. No clipping or unresolved text/line collision remains.

text_line_collision_check.method: Rendered text boxes inset1.5px against all line and patch paths, including arcs/circles/polygons; supplemented by actual visual inspection

style_normalizations: 768×768 opaque white; protocol black 1pt primitives; DejaVu Sans point names18pt and values16pt; no question or answer embedded.
Decorative source colors removed; named objects, continuous topology, semantic dashed lines and any meaningful shaded region retained.
Original angle callout leaders, when present, are replaced by a direct bound label and exactly one angle arc; no equality or auxiliary geometry is implied.
Source distance arrows, where present, are normalized to perpendicular solid connectors and a parallel dashed dimension line.
